item.content:encoded:
That was a tough decision, and I must say that your writing ability won the day, but just barely. I am not very fond of Skip Weaponization, and their idea of turning the thing into living grenades did push it too far.

But since it doesn't reveal if such idea would actually get approved in the end, I'll upvote this, because you really wrote it well and I liked both the tamer and the taming process.

I'll read the previous and next tale later, but I can't say the chances of me liking them are very high.

item.title: who let the dogs out
item.content:encoded:
I wanna be the very best --
Like no one ever was!

To catch them is my real test --
TO TRAIN THEM IS MY CAUSE!

- POKÉMON THEME

AUTHOR NOTES
– hide block

Yes, this is a continuation of Oh-Fucking-Seventy-Six. The idea is to build an anomalous MTF task-force (akin to Resurrection) using anomalous assets.

Or, in other words: an anomalous superhero squad.

Unlike Oh-Fucking-Seventy-Six, this is not a stand-alone piece. It's a two-parter. I'll hopefully have the second part (the conclusion for this) up by the end of this weekend.
